description: OpenAI Whisper base model running on whisper.cpp, a dependency-free C/C++ inference engine optimized for CPU (AVX, Arm Neon, mixed F16/F32).
notes: Plugin default model; ggml weights auto-downloaded on first load. Langs pinned to the language set actually exercised in scoring (Whisper is auto-detect/multilingual by design, but an empty langs list made this fighter eligible against every board rather than only the ones it was evaluated on).
